title: Human Resource Management in public sector organisations

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, methods, and techniques of human resource management in public sector organizations.
Compare and contrast HR management practices between public and private sector organizations.
Analyze job roles within public sector organizations.
Develop recruitment strategies for public sector organizations.
Design training programs for public sector employees.
Implement performance evaluation systems for public sector employees.
Manage salary and benefits structures for public sector employees.
